description: This is a CMake script file that defines a function 'compile_aidl' used in the build process to generate source code from AIDL files based on specified parameters such as language, include directories, and target output directories. The script includes detailed comments on usage and options, and handles locating the 'aidl' compiler, setting default flags, and executing the compilation command.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function that compiles AIDL files into source code with configurable options such as language, include directories, and output directory. It finds the 'aidl' compiler, prepares command-line arguments, and executes the compilation process, handling success or failure accordingly.
